about: V1's live fight camera: the Origins zone page's 'Wide auto-fit' combat framing (RPG-game trunk 82a994d15: origins/preview/preview-rules-defs.json:48-76, placement src/fight/follow-camera.ts:66-88, FOV origins/preview/main.ts:158, shiftY as a view offset main.ts:551). The eye sits behind the player's heading, `side` over the right shoulder; the gaze starts `ahead` in front and moves `mid` of the way to the fighters' midpoint. back grows with the gap (perSep) at most fitRate m/s, clamped to [minBack, maxBack], and what the cap takes goes into height x0.5. The eye eases at `follow`/s.
